faqs.a: AI documentation tool for behavioral health providers. Transcribes therapy and psychiatry sessions and generates structured clinical notes. Designed for mental health workflows.

faqs.q: Is OneStep Scribe for mental health specifically?
faqs.a: Yes. OneStep Scribe focuses on behavioral health documentation—therapy sessions, psychiatric evaluations, and medication management visits.
AI listens to your session, transcribes the conversation, and drafts a note based on your template preferences. You review and finalize before saving.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA available for healthcare providers.

faqs.q: Can I try OneStep Scribe before buying?
faqs.a: Contact them for trial availability. Many AI scribes offer free trials to test with your workflow.

faqs.q: How does OneStep Scribe compare to other options?
faqs.a: OneStep Scribe is one of several mental health AI scribes. Compare with Upheal, Mentalyc, and Blueprint based on your EHR integration needs and documentation preferences.
